ai_providers.list.title: List AI providers
ai_providers.list.description: Page through the model providers; filter by status, vendor and default, and search code, name and chat model. API keys are never returned.
ai_providers.get.title: Get an AI provider
ai_providers.get.description: Read a model provider's settings; the API key is never returned, only whether one is set.
ai_providers.create.title: Create an AI provider
ai_providers.create.description: Add an OpenAI-compatible model provider. The code is unique and cannot change; the API key is stored encrypted; making it the default clears the previous default.
ai_providers.update.title: Update an AI provider
ai_providers.update.description: Edit a model provider. Leave the API key empty to keep the current one and send back the concurrency stamp you read. New calls use the new settings once the change is committed.
ai_providers.set_status.title: Enable or disable an AI provider
ai_providers.set_status.description: Enable or disable a model provider; disabled providers cannot be used for chat or embeddings. Send back the concurrency stamp you read; a remark replaces the current one.
ai_providers.set_default.title: Set the default AI provider
ai_providers.set_default.description: Make an enabled model provider the default and clear the others; assistants and the knowledge base use it when they name no provider.
ai_providers.delete.title: Delete AI providers
ai_providers.test.title: Test an AI provider
ai_providers.test.description: Send "ping" to the chat model with the current settings and, when an embedding model is set, embed it once and report the dimensions (disabled providers can be tested too). Failures are reported in the result, not as a failed call.
ai.providers.code_taken: An AI provider with code '{code}' already exists.
ai.providers.disabled: AI provider '{code}' is disabled and cannot be made the default.
ai.providers.endpoint_invalid: The endpoint must be an absolute http or https URL.
ai.providers.secret_unreadable: The API key of AI provider '{code}' cannot be decrypted; the data protection keys may have changed. Enter it again.
ai.providers.kind_unavailable: No model provider for the OpenAI-compatible protocol is installed.
ai.provider.secret_required: Enter the secret again after changing the connection address: the old secret is not sent to a new address.

permissions.ai.ai_providers.read.descrip: View the model providers; API keys are never shown.

permissions.ai.ai_providers.update.name: Update AI providers

permissions.ai.ai_providers.execute.desc: Send a test request to a model provider's chat and embedding models.
ai_prompts.list.title: List AI prompts
ai_prompts.list.description: Page through the prompts; filter by status and category and search code and name. The list does not include the content.
ai_prompts.get.title: Get an AI prompt
ai_prompts.get.description: Read a prompt with its content.
ai_prompts.create.title: Create an AI prompt
ai_prompts.create.description: Add a prompt. The code is unique and cannot change; the content is used as-is as an assistant's system prompt without variable rendering, and the version is only a label.
ai_prompts.update.title: Update an AI prompt
ai_prompts.update.description: Edit a prompt; the code cannot change. Send back the concurrency stamp you read.
ai_prompts.set_status.title: Enable or disable an AI prompt
ai_prompts.set_status.description: Enable or disable a prompt. Send back the concurrency stamp you read; a remark replaces the current one.
ai_prompts.delete.title: Delete AI prompts
ai.prompts.code_taken: An AI prompt with code '{code}' already exists.
openapi.tags.ai_prompts.name: AI prompts
openapi.tags.ai_prompts.description: System prompts for assistants: create, read, update, delete, enable and disable. The content is used as-is without variable rendering; the version is only a label.
permissions.ai.ai_prompts.read.name: Read AI prompts
permissions.ai.ai_prompts.read.descripti: View the prompts and their content.
permissions.ai.ai_prompts.create.name: Create AI prompts
permissions.ai.ai_prompts.update.name: Update AI prompts
permissions.ai.ai_prompts.delete.name: Delete AI prompts
knowledge_documents.list.title: List knowledge documents
knowledge_documents.list.description: Page through the knowledge documents on the caller's side; filter by source type and status and search title and source. The list does not include the content.
knowledge_documents.get.title: Get a knowledge document
knowledge_documents.get.description: Read a knowledge document on the caller's side with its content.
knowledge_documents.ingest.title: Ingest a knowledge document
knowledge_documents.ingest.description: Chunk, embed and store a text in the knowledge base on the caller's side, synchronously within the request. If indexing fails the document is saved as failed and returned successfully with the reason, and it can be reindexed.
knowledge_documents.reindex.title: Reindex a knowledge document
knowledge_documents.reindex.description: Rechunk and re-embed from the content. Extra chunks of the old version are removed only after the new chunks are written; on failure the old chunks stay searchable and the reason is recorded on the document.
knowledge_documents.delete.title: Delete knowledge documents
knowledge_documents.delete.description: Delete knowledge documents on the caller's side together with their chunks in the vector store. If the vector store is unreachable that item fails and the document stays.
knowledge_documents.query.title: Ask the knowledge base
knowledge_documents.query.description: Search the knowledge base on the caller's side and optionally generate an answer; [n] in the answer refers to the n-th chunk.
knowledge_documents.search.title: Search the knowledge base
knowledge_documents.search.description: Semantic search over the knowledge base on the caller's side for a question or keywords. Returns the most relevant chunks with document, title, source, score and text.
ai.providers.in_use: Provider "{code}" is still used by assistants or knowledge documents and cannot be deleted.
ai.knowledge_documents.provider_unavaila: Embedding provider "{code}" does not exist or is disabled.
openapi.tags.knowledge_documents.name: Knowledge base
openapi.tags.knowledge_documents.descrip: Ingest, reindex and delete knowledge documents, ask and search the knowledge base. The platform and each tenant keep their own and cannot see each other's.
View this side's knowledge documents and their content.
permissions.ai.knowledge_documents.creat: Add text documents to this side's knowledge base.
permissions.ai.knowledge_documents.updat: Rebuild the index of a knowledge document from its content.
permissions.ai.knowledge_documents.delet: Delete knowledge documents and their vectors.
permissions.ai.knowledge_documents.execu: Search this side's knowledge base and ask questions against it.
ai_assistants.list.title: List AI assistants
ai_assistants.list.description: Page through the assistants; filter by status and search code and name.
ai_assistants.get.title: Get an AI assistant
ai_assistants.create.title: Create an AI assistant
ai_assistants.create.description: Add an assistant. The code is unique and cannot change; referenced prompts and providers must exist and be enabled, and tools must be in the tool catalog.
ai_assistants.update.title: Update an AI assistant
ai_assistants.update.description: Edit an assistant's configuration. The code cannot change, enabling and disabling is a separate operation, and the concurrency stamp you read must be returned.
ai_assistants.set_status.title: Enable or disable an AI assistant
ai_assistants.set_status.description: Enable or disable an assistant. Once disabled it no longer appears among the assistants in chat, and existing conversations cannot ask further questions.
ai_assistants.set_default.title: Set the default AI assistant
ai_assistants.set_default.description: Make an assistant the default and clear the others. A disabled assistant cannot be the default.
ai_assistants.delete.title: Delete AI assistants
ai_assistants.delete.description: Delete assistants. Existing conversations are kept but cannot ask further questions.
ai_assistants.tools.title: List assistant tools
ai_assistants.tools.description: List the tools an assistant can use (read-only operations that run as the caller), and tell the form whether a vector store is configured.
ai.prompts.in_use: Prompt "{code}" is still used by assistants and cannot be deleted.
